notes.title: Your Feedback Shapes the Development Process
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45605936/afec97f10b6b09cf562cf0c0a19cc110973c9255.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The game is now strictly [b]2-player co-op![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Enemies added[/p][/*][*][p]Double jump added[/p][/*][*][p]Long jump reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Button system redesigned[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced network traffic usage[/p][/*][/list][p]As you know, I develop this game [b]solo[/b], and I carefully track your feedback and suggestions. [b]Every change is based on your preferences.[/b] Your voice matters—only together can we create the [b]best co-op adventure.[/b][/p][p]From the bottom of my heart, thank you to everyone who bought the game and left a review. Even your [b]brief, hastily written comment[/b] helps push the game up Steam’s rankings. Thank you again![/p]
